pages.text: The Basic Processor is the entry-level processor used to craft basic Refined Storage devices. It is the foundation for more advanced processors and components.
Features:$(li)Used in basic device recipes$(li)Required for early-game automation$(li)Used in storage and network components$(li)Can be upgraded to Improved Processor
To craft the Basic Processor:$(li)First craft a Raw Basic Processor$(li)Smelt the Raw Basic Processor in a furnace$(li)Combine with Processor Binding$(li)Requires basic resources
